# rt/term

> Terminals: detecting one, and ANSI colors that respect NO_COLOR.

truck [rt](../rt.md) · [source](../../../registry/rt/term.pkg)

```
let color = term_colors(2)                         // for stderr
io_err(term_paint("✓ done", TERM_GREEN, color))
```

| function | does |
|---|---|
| `term_is_tty(fd: int) -> bool` | is the file descriptor a terminal (`ioctl TCGETS`) |
| `term_colors(fd: int) -> bool` | a terminal, and `NO_COLOR` unset ([no-color.org](https://no-color.org)) |
| `term_paint(s: str, style: str, on: bool) -> str` | wrap `s` in the ANSI style if `on` (and `s` isn't empty) |

Styles are constants that can be combined with `;`: `TERM_BOLD`,
`TERM_DIM`, `TERM_RED`, `TERM_GREEN`, `TERM_YELLOW`, `TERM_BLUE`,
`TERM_MAGENTA`, `TERM_CYAN`, e.g.
`str_concat(TERM_BOLD, str_concat(";", TERM_RED))`.

## Library code

Merged into every program that uses this package.

```
const TERM_BOLD = "1"
const TERM_DIM = "2"
const TERM_RED = "31"
const TERM_GREEN = "32"
const TERM_YELLOW = "33"
const TERM_BLUE = "34"
const TERM_MAGENTA = "35"
const TERM_CYAN = "36"

fn term_is_tty(fd: int) -> bool
  let termios = make([u8], 64)
  return syscall(16, fd, 21505, &termios[0]) == 0
end

fn term_colors(fd: int) -> bool
  return term_is_tty(fd) && os_getenv("NO_COLOR") == ""
end

fn term_paint(s: str, style: str, on: bool) -> str
  if !on || s == ""
    return s
  end
  let open = str_concat(str_concat("\x1b[", style), "m")
  return str_concat(str_concat(open, s), "\x1b[0m")
end
```
